_comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Section 6.2 of SP 800-140C cut into rows by ../schema/build.derived.py: one object per citation (plus the SKIPJACK note row), each with source_lines and the quote written from them. Every row validates against ../schema/ApprovedSecurityFunctionReference.derived.schema.json. The requirements lane owns these rows as requirements; this file is their machine form.
